Day 20 (old art) - January 2016 (age 13)

yoooo we hit 20 days right at the start of a new year! isn't that neat?

so this is a time where I was really into pencil and I was dipping my toes into flower-mandala-thingies

you will see those much more once we get to my art from 2022 (which will come faster than you might think haha!)

obligatory cat whiskers in the top corner of course and the fella dancing is inspired by the ending song of free!
